output.patientMessage: Call 911 now and stay resting until help arrives — do not drive yourself. Crushing central chest pressure lasting 30 minutes with left-arm radiation, sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, which needs an ECG and blood tests immediately. If symptoms ease before help arrives, still go — do not cancel. If you collapse or someone finds you unresponsive, they should tell the 911 dispatcher immediately.
